reviews.title: Unreliable, Unintuitive, and Incredibly Frustrating
reviews.text:
I’ve used Family Link for about a year and a half to manage my child’s Android phone from my iPhone, and it has consistently been a terrible experience.

The app hardly works properly. It almost never works the first time I open it. It will frequently just sit there unresponsive, forcing me to close it, reopen it, back out, and try again just to access basic controls.

Even when it does work, the app is incredibly unintuitive. There are menus buried within menus, basic settings are unnecessarily difficult to find, and managing what’s happening on my child’s phone takes far more effort than it should. Location services are also frustratingly laggy and unreliable.

A parental-control app needs to be fast, intuitive, and dependable—especially when a parent needs to access something immediately. After a year and a half, Family Link has been none of those things.

Terrible app. Highly not recommended.

reviews.title: Not good for neurodivergent people
reviews.text:
I am twelve years old and autistic and I find comfort from being on my phone. Not always social media. Even just looking at photos or reading back me can distract me from an overwhelming environment, bad thoughts and many other things. With the restrictions I have I can rarely do that. 

My parents have the ability to “lock” my phone. What only comes with stress and frustration, I have a thing called “downtime” on my phone what means after a certain time it turns off. Some time I feel the need to interact with media from different interests. Not being able to has led to private meltdown and to be honest self harm. (If you wonder why I say private it’s because I am more comfortable by myself).

It makes you feel like you’re being controlled. I can’t download apps without permission, I can’t sign into simple things like apps without permission, I have timers on apps and many things I haven’t written down

 I able to recognise my needs as an autistic child and I know why this app is so harmful. This app is ruining thousands of kids mental health. Don’t let your child be a victim.

reviews.title: Limited utility for multiple devices
reviews.text: With an iPhone and a tablet handled within the app there are problems. 1) Banned apps cannot be banned per device, which isn’t useful when we want the tablet for leisure and the phone for practical things. 2. The app does not work well for time limits across multiple devices. I cannot apply a time per device, only a total time across devices. But the total time I set isn’t spread across the devices, it is applied to each device! One or the other would not be great, but still better than this irrational approach. Want to set an hour on the phone and 2 on the tablet? Nope. Ok, then I’ll set a total of 3 hours. Great, now we have 3 x2 devices = 6 hours. Ok make it 1.5 hours then, we’ll now she’s moaning because she doesn’t want that proportion of her allowance allocated against her phone. The app has one job and it is not doing it well right now.

I ended up having to delete all the Gmail accounts associated with it just to get access to the tablet again. The amount of information I lost makes it possibly the worst app ive ever used. Save yourself the headache and tears and find something else. Do not use this app.

reviews.title: Avoid like the plague
reviews.text:
Impossible to remove

Imagine your child’s school assigns homework that requires your child to view a clip on YouTube.  YouTube is not accessible by your child or you have installed Family Link so now your child can’t do their homework.  Imagine you try to remove Family link.  Well, that too doesn’t work.  Now your child can’t do their homework and you can’t change their settings.  After countless hours online trying to find instructions, and hours of trying to find guidance online (don’t even dream that of contacting a human at FamilyLink!) you learn that you need to do a factory reset of your child’s computer, which will wipe all the child’s work on that computer.  

Save yourself and your child and your family hours of frustration by avoiding this app like the plague.
